authority.allowed: Read fixed source, original CI evidence and primary documentation; create unreachable qualification-review blobs.
not_performed: No production token/ACL/loader/DLL edit or patch.
No permission experiment or native execution.
No skip, timeout, expected-result or capability broadening.
authority.approval_gate: Earlier automatic approval rejection for production security-boundary changes remains in force. This design does not bypass it.

identity.duplicate_log_rule: The later wrapper tail repeats the same PIDs, fixture paths, failures and 4.39s summary. It is not a second native reproduction.

original_cases.name: token::tests::partial_delete_deny_is_repaired_before_native_workspace_writes
original_cases.observed: Repeated repair tuple is (true,true,true), expected (false,true,false); stored directory ACE count 11->13, direct file 8->9.
preserved_oracles: First repair true and both overwrite/create PermissionDenied.
Read/content remain 'before repair'; created file absent.

original_cases.name: token::tests::workspace_capabilities_deny_writes_and_deletes_under_broad_identity_aces
original_cases.observed: Overwrite/create yield PermissionDenied raw OS 5; remove_file/remove_dir return success; parent observation finds both objects NotFound raw OS 2.
preserved_oracles: All four outside operations must return PermissionDenied.
Outside original contents and directory must remain; outside-created file absent.
Both allowed roots must allow create and deletion with physical postconditions.
Allowed capability a/b present, unrelated/logon/Everyone excluded from restriction matches.

original_cases.name: unified_exec::tests::legacy_workspace_write_delete_is_limited_to_writable_roots
original_cases.observed: Real cmd.exe child exits 0 and deletes three allowed files, but also removes outside file and protected .git; both parent metadata observations are NotFound.
preserved_oracles: Original real child, command body, private desktop and 5000ms child/10s collection budgets remain.
Physical post-exit filesystem observations remain authoritative; child exit 0 alone is not a deny proof.

established_dacl_cause.query: acl.rs dacl_has_complete_deny_for_sid maps masks but accepts only leading explicit unconditional deny entries with exact flags 0x03.
established_dacl_cause.inference: All observed complete normalized entries fail the exact flags==0x03 comparison, so already_present returns false and the unchanged setter adds another deny. The source predicate plus real stored ACEs and counts establish this cause.
established_dacl_cause.limit: This establishes repair idempotence failure, not the root cause of outside deletion.

dacl_repair_design.scope: Future reviewed production change only to recognition of already-installed complete deny scope; no ACL permission mask, token policy or ordering relaxation.
dacl_repair_design.object_kind: Use explicit file-versus-directory scope at the path-aware callsite; current no-path predicate cannot distinguish their contracts.
dacl_repair_design.file_rule: A leading explicit effective full-mask deny for the exact SID is enough for a file. Inherited-only coverage is not an explicit repair certificate; first direct repair must still return true.
dacl_repair_design.directory_rule: Require complete effective denial on the directory AND complete recursive object+container propagation. A complete 0x03 entry supplies both; the complete 0x00 plus 0x0b pair for the same SID is another representation.
strictness: Keep generic-to-specific comparison with the existing filesystem mapping.
Keep prefix/order boundary: an earlier allow, unknown/conditional/object-specific ACE or inherited entry cannot certify a later deny.
Do not accept inherit-only alone, self-only alone for a directory, no-propagate, missing object/container scope, unrelated SID or partial mask.
Do not combine unrelated SIDs or arbitrarily union partial ACEs to satisfy a complete mask.
Do not rewrite/reorder/deduplicate existing ACLs merely to match the query representation.
Keep errors as errors and preserve explicit-versus-inherited semantics.
necessary_controls: Existing complete_denies_require_effective_recursive_scope_and_precede_allows remains a directory-scope negative control; flags 0 alone must still fail there.
New native normalized-pair positive, each-half-only negatives, wrong SID, partial-rights, no-propagate and allow-before-deny negatives.
File native first direct repair true and second false, with byte-equal DACL and unchanged ACE count on the second call.
Directory first repair true and second false; capture the actual DACL after setter normalization, not only an in-memory synthetic ACL.
Existing partial_read_deny_is_repaired_before_native_file_data_access and deny_ace_update_failure_is_an_error remain mandatory because the query is shared with read denies.

established: The actual token matches allowed a/b restricting SIDs and does not match unrelated, logon or Everyone SIDs in five original probes; source passes capability-only restricting entries for this legacy factory.
The outside object has a broad identity DELETE route and its parent has a broad identity FILE_DELETE_CHILD route; both exist together in the current fixture.
Actual deletion and post-impersonation/post-child disappearance are proven, so this is not a renamed error or missing setup helper.

unresolved_hypotheses.hypothesis: The actual deletion rights may avoid the capability-restricted write check.
unresolved_hypotheses.not_proven: Microsoft documents write-only restricting SID checks but does not resolve this exact filesystem delete path from this evidence.

unresolved_hypotheses.hypothesis: The filesystem may authorize deletion via parent FILE_DELETE_CHILD even when the object path would be denied.
unresolved_hypotheses.not_proven: Current fixture grants both parent and object deletion routes; no controlled removal of one route has been observed.

unresolved_hypotheses.hypothesis: The particular active token, inherited handles, enabled privileges or Win32 operation path may affect the effective check.
unresolved_hypotheses.not_proven: Five SID-membership probes and source flags are not a complete active child-token/handle audit.

prohibited_shortcuts: Add Everyone/logon/user identity as a capability.
Drop WRITE_RESTRICTED without qualifying read/load/IPC semantics.
Treat acl idempotence repair as a deletion fix.
Rewrite global parent ACLs or machine security policy.
Force a setup or loader error so the destructive branch never runs.
Change expected errors, skip or filter the original failing cases.

discriminating_controls_design.authorization: Design only. Creating or executing altered-token/ACL controls requires the existing security approval gate to be resolved first.
discriminating_controls_design.fixture_boundary: Owned disposable fixture trees only; no production Root, host parent ACL, DLL search path or global token policy changes.

object_parent_matrix.purpose: No identity delete route; mandatory deny control.

discriminating_controls_design.acl_integrity: Verify all relevant effective ACEs and inherited grants on both object and parent so alternate enabled identities cannot silently reintroduce the route being removed. Preserve the outside-other-capability negative.
discriminating_controls_design.token_matrix: Keep the current exact factory as the product baseline. An unmodified identity token can validate the fixture rights matrix; a separately reviewed full-restriction diagnostic token may test the flag hypothesis, but its result is not a production fix.
discriminating_controls_design.operations: Keep the original Rust filesystem and real legacy cmd child operations. Any exact-rights handle/AccessCheck observation is supplemental; fresh actual operations and parent physical readback decide the outcome.
observations: Actual active impersonation or child token identity, restriction roster, enabled/deny-only groups and privileges, integrity level, token type; no credential values.
Complete DACL role/ACE type/flags/SID-category/mask for object and parent, with bytes/hash and no truncated diagnostic claim.
No reused privileged object handles; capture requested operation, native error and lifecycle of new handles.
Parent observations after impersonation ends or actual child exit: original content, existence, directory type and allowed-root side effects.
Exact source commit/tree/toolchain, exact test roster, original XML/log, no retries and before/after source invariance.
discriminating_controls_design.decision_rule: Only select a production deletion enforcement design after the matrix identifies which check is bypassed; both object DELETE and parent DELETE_CHILD must remain within the declared capability policy. A broader restriction model must separately preserve legitimate read, loader, desktop and IPC access.

routing_scope.observed_source: Normal workspace-write/override requests select the elevated backend. Current backend-selection original tests pass.
routing_scope.residual: lib.rs publicly re-exports the direct legacy spawn entry and capability-only token factory. Their original contracts still fail.
routing_scope.conclusion: Do not assert every normal Windows entry point reproduced the same deletion behavior; do not close the demonstrated legacy/token boundary failure using ordinary routing.

mandatory_positive_controls: All existing backend-selection and ACL-setup-before-spawn rejection cases
acceptance.additional_ipc_requirement: If token restriction/default DACL policy changes, require an actual restricted child to load the original executable/DLLs and complete bidirectional IPC plus a child-created object accessibility control; isolated channel unit tests alone do not qualify token ACL compatibility.
acceptance.ignored_semantics: Existing STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED ignores remain explicitly unqualified; do not convert them into passes or add new ignores.
acceptance.final_platform_gate: Original Windows x86_64-pc-windows-msvc Bazel target and workflow, unchanged filters/retries/budgets, at the exact approved production candidate. Full JUnit/test.log and actual checkout/tree must be collected.
acceptance.completion_rule: All three original tests execute and pass with original strict assertions; new causal negatives fail only at their intended security oracle; positive loader/IPC/read/allowed-root controls pass; security review authorizes the exact production diff. Until then the three cases remain OPEN.

primary_sources.supports: WRITE_RESTRICTED write-only restriction scope; not proof of the exact delete-path cause.
Deletion may be authorized by object DELETE or parent delete-child; deletion effects depend on handle lifecycle.
Effective versus inherit-only ACEs, generic mapping and split representations.
Native ACL setters propagate inheritable ACEs and preserve ordering semantics.
Generic read/write mappings overlap in SYNCHRONIZE, requiring read/loader compatibility controls for any restriction change.
Order-sensitive access checks and explicit/inherited deny/allow ordering.
